Commentary.Commentary: Right! First PNG. Then Ireland. Then Netherlands. And now, Namibia. Four teams have qualified for the 2020 WT20 in Australia. UAE and Oman have got another chance when they play on Wednesday. Can they grab that opportunity? Join us for another double-header with Scotland meeting UAE at 2.10 pm local (1010 GMT), followed by the Hong Kong-Oman clash at 7.30 pm local (1530 GMT). Do join us. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Victorious Namibian skipper, Gerhard Erasmus, credits the team and staff for the success. Erasmus, says that at 69/5, they needed someone to step up and they had a couple of guys do it. Adds that the Powerplay didn't go their way but Williams kept the run score ticking. Mentions that he wants more people to play the sport back home and adds that that will happen once this side does well on the world stage. Thanks the entire staff for looking after the squad.

Oman captain, Zeeshan Maqsood, says that it was a tough game for them. On their superb start, Maqsood says that the innings from Khawar was superb. Says that the ball was not coming on the bat well and hence they could not rotate the strike well. On their match on Wednesday, Zeeshan says that they will try their best to make it to the World Cup. Adds that they will look after where things went wrong for them.

JJ Smit gets the MAN OF THE MATCH award for his superb innings. He now chats with Ian Bishop. On the entire proceedings today, Smit says that he is a relieved man right now. Mentions that he has been on the wrong side of the line on a few occasions earlier. Adds that the side never gives up and keeps working hard. On their celebration, Smit says that people back home believed in their unit. Points that people across the world sent them good wishes and they have done it. On his batting, JJ says that the batsman needs to stay focused. Adds that there could always be dots but at the same time, poor balls will come too.

Oman will be looking back at that first innings and thinking, what went wrong at 69/5. How come the bowling, which had conceded just 82 in 14 overs, conceded almost the same number of runs in the next 6 overs. Thoughts to ponder. JJ Smit came in at number 7 and blasted 59 from just 25 balls - that is how deep Namibia bat. That influx of Albie Morkel in the coaching staff has been productive, hasn't it? Here comes the presentation.

Excellent bowling by Namibia. They stuck to their guns and even though they were taken to the cleaners during the Powerplay, they stuck to their guns. It was a matter of one wicket and that is what happened. Scholtz and Erasmus stifled them after that second wicket, sharing combined figures of 8-0-33-6.

Normally, in this tournament, whenever 150 has been crossed, very few times has it been chased. And tonight, was not one of the few. Namibia's acceleration with the bat in the final 6 overs meant that a dangerous score had been reached from Oman's point of view. There was a brief partnership of 57 for the second wicket when Oman had a bit of a chance but once Ilyas was dismissed, the floodgates were opened. After that, it was a procession.

The entire Namibian squad is on the ground, hugging their mates who played this match. Elation for them. They have become the fourth team to get their name etched in the WT20 participants in 2020. Oman look disconsolate. They have another chance left though.

OUT! Game over! Namibia celebrates as they book their ticket for Australia. They celebrate in the huddle. A few of them are in tears too. Coming to the ball, it is a shortish length ball outside off, Butt looks to pull it but the ball takes the top edge and lobs towards short third man where Kotze takes an easy catch. NAMIBIA WIN BY 54 RUNS AND ARE GOING AUSTRALIA TO PLAY THE T20 WORLD CUP.
Full around off, Bilal looks to drive it through the off side but the ball takes the inner half and goes towards deep square leg. No runs taken.
WIDE! Why? Because too high. Bilal goes for the pull but misses.
Full outside off, pushed towards point.
Just misses the stumps and an outside edge too. Full around off, Butt looks to drive but misses because of the late swing.
Full outside off, Fayaz drills the ball towards long off for a single.
Full on the pads, Bilal this time turns it wide of the short leg fielder and takes a single.
Looking for the yorker, Frylinck dishes out a low full toss. Bilal does well to keep it out.
Swing and a miss this time. Landed around off and middle, Butt goes for the hoick but can't make any connection. Went over the stumps there.
Length ball outside off, Fayaz slams it towards long off and denies the run.
Full around off, Bilal looks to hammer it over deep mid-wicket but mistimes the shot towards mid on for a single.
Bouncer outside off, Bilal goes for the pull this time but again fails to put any bat on the ball.
Full outside off, Bilal swings hard but misses.
Bilal Khan is the last man in.

OUT! He strikes first ball and Oman are 9 down. Namibia just a wicket away from booking their tickets for the T20 World Cup in Australia. A full straight ball, Nawaz looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. A huge appeal follows and the umpire raises the finger.
JJ Smit to bowl the 18th over.
Around middle, Butt looks to scoop it over the keeper but misses.
Bouncer on middle, Nawaz pulls towards deep mid-wicket and takes a run.
Outside off, Butt looks to drive but gets an inside edge and the ball goes towards fine leg for a single.
Shortish length ball this time, Butt pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full again, pushed towards long off for a run.
Starts with a full ball outside off, Nawaz goes after it but can't put any bat on the ball.
Jan Frylinck is back. 2-0-15-1 from him.
Full around off and middle, pushed towards long on for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Wide! Bouncer down the leg side. Butt looks to pull but misses. Called wide.
Full outside off, Kurram creams his off drive but just a single as there is protection at long off.
Outside off, guided towards third man for a single.
Fayyaz Butt is the next man in.
OUT! Caught! Short ball outside off, Nadeem looks to guide it over short third man but finds short third man where Koetze takes easiest of the catches.
Outside off, pushed towards covers for a single.
Craig Williams is back into the attack. 1-0-2-0 so far from him.
Landed outside off, played straight to point.
Outside off, a slash and a miss.
Full and around off, Nadeem looks to defend but the ball comes back in a long way and hits him on the pads. Probably an inside edge involved.
Outside off, a slash and a miss.
Outside off, Nadeem slashes hard but misses.
A short ball outside off, Nawaz mistimes his pull towards long on for a single.
JJ Smit is back on. 1-0-10-0 so far.
Another ball on the pads, Nawaz turns it towards leg side and takes a run.
On the pads, Khurram looks to nudge it towards fine leg but the ball hits the pads and goes towards short fine leg. Run given by the umpire though. Surprising!
Mohammad Nadeem is the new man in.

OUT! Caught and bowled! Erasmus gets his third wicket. A loopy full ball outside off, Goud looks to slog sweep but the ball takes the top edge and goes high in the air toward mid on. Erasmus calls the catch mine and then takes it comfortably.
On the pads, worked straight to mid-wicket.
Fires this one way outside off, Goud reaches out at the ball but makes no connection. The bowler appeals but the umpire deems it wide.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Sprays down the leg side this time. Goud looks to flick but misses. The keeper fumbles but no run taken. However, called wide.
On the hips, Nawaz this time turns this towards mid-wicket and takes a couple.
Outside off, guided towards point.
Flighted ball on off and middle, Goud pushes it towards cover and takes off for a single. The fielder there looks to run the non-striker out but misses his throw.
Another ball outside off, Nawaz nudges it towards point for a single.
Outside off, tapped towards point for a single now.
Around off, Goud pushes it towards cover and charges for a run. The non-striker sends him back. The fielder there throws the ball to the keeper but Goud returns in time.
Khurram Nawaz walks in at number 8, replacing Aamir Kaleem. Two new batters at the crease.

OUT! Another one bites the dust. Scholtz has his 3rd victim. Another flighted ball around off, Kaleem this time looks to slog sweep by coming down the track but he can't make a proper connection. The ball goes straight to deep mid-wicket where Frylinck takes another catch.
The batsman has played it fine down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Full toss ball this time, Kaleem pushes it behind square leg for a single.
Quicker and flatter ball on the pads, Kaleem looks to tuck it towards the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads. The bowler appeal but the umpire turns it down.
Outside off, driven for a single through cover.
Sandeep Goud is the next man in.

OUT! Caught this time and Suraj Kumar is the latest man who needs to head into the pavilion. A full ball around off, Suraj slog sweeps but can only find Frylinck at deep square leg. Half the side in the hut for Oman.
Full ball around off, drives towards short mid-wicket.
Quicker one on the pads, Suraj pushes it towards the leg side for a run.
Flighted ball on middle,  Suraj looks to push it towards the leg side but gets a leading edge towards cover.
Full around off, Kaleem sweeps it behind square leg for a single.
Quicker one on the pads, Kumar turns it towards the leg side for a single.
On middle, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.

DROPPED! Good effort but he should've done better there. Flighted ball around off, Kaleem sweeps it uppishly towards deep square leg. Now, the fielder there does not pick it initially and hence runs late. Gets to the ball a bit late and shells it. A couple taken.
Short and outside off, cut through point for another single.
Around middle and off, worked through mid-wicket for one.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full and around off, swept through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.

That was close. Full and around middle, Kaleem looks to sweep but misses and goes off the pads towards short fine leg. There is a massive appeal for LBW but it is turned down. Ah... inside edge. A single taken.
Full on the pads, Kaleem works it behind square for a single.
Flighted around off, Suraj looks to ease it through mid off but gets a leading edge. The ball goes towards long off uppishly for a single.
Around off, pushed through mid off for a single.

DROPPED! Unbelievable. The hero with the bat has put down a dolly. Flighted full ball on middle, Suraj looks to flick but the ball takes outside edge and goes high in the air towards long on. JJ Smit runs in from long on, settles under the ball but then spills it. A single taken.
Suraj Kumar is the next man in.

OUT! Stumped! The skipper is out of here. Maybe after a quick couple of wickets, he could've played calmly. But no and he falls prey. Flighted ball around off, Khawar Ali has a wild swing at the ball but misses it altogether. The ball goes behind to the keeper who whips the bails off in a jiffy to send the Omani skipper packing.
Flighted ball around off, Khawar looks  to check his shot towards mid off but gets a leading edge which falls just short of the bowler.
Full around middle this time, Khawar sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
On the pads, Kaleem turns it behind square leg for a single.
WIDE! Fires it way outside off. Kaleem lets it go the keeper. Called wide by the umpire.
Aamir Kaleem walks in at number 5, replacing his skipper.

Out! Caught! Erasmus removes his opposite number! Flighted ball outside off, Zeeshan looks to drive it over the long off fence but can't do so from the middle of the bat. It stays well inside the boundary where Davin takes simplest of the catches. Two wickets inside two overs.
Fuller ball outside off, Khawar drives it through mid off for a single.
Full on the pads, Khawar sweeps but fails to make proper connection as the ball goes towards short fine leg.
Flighted ball outside off, Zeeshan guides it towards short third man for a quick single.
Gerhard Erasmus to bowl now!
Around off, Zeeshan tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a run and to get off the mark. 2 runs and a wicket from the over.
Flighted ball on middle, Maqsood this time looks to work it towards the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Beaten! Good bowling. Fires this one outside off, Zeeshan looks to push it off the back foot but is beaten.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Zeeshan Maqsood walks in now, at number 4, replacing Ilyas.

OUT! LBW! Scholtz strikes and the partnership is broken. Full ball on middle, Ilyas goes sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. It looked as if the ball went on to hit the stumps but that wasn't the case. It kisses the pads of the batsman and then goes towards the keeper. A huge appeal follows and the umpire raises the finger.
He starts with a ball on middle, Ali looks to reverse sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball goes towards short mid-wicket for a leg bye.
Bernard Scholtz with his spin into the attack now.
Shortish length, Ali punches this through mid on for an easy run now.
On middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
Length ball outside off, Ilyas goes for a massive heave but misses to put any bat on the ball.
Shortish ball around off, Ilyas punches it towards point. The fielder there throws the ball to the keeper who makes an acrobatic stop. Could've been overthrows there.
Ouch! Length ball on middle and leg, Aaqib looks to pull by getting down low. But the ball hits his shoulder and goes to hit on the helmet.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Craig Williams to bowl now.
Around off, Khawar pushes it back to the bowler.

SIX! Whoa! Sensational batting. 50-run partnership is up too. Fuller length ball on middle, Khawar gets to the pitch of the ball and slams this over the long on fence for the second maximum of the over.
On middle, Ilyas guides it late towards point and takes a single.

FOUR! Viljoen is not learning and he continues getting the stick from the Omani batters. Short and on middle, this time it is Ilyas who pulls this one to the deep square leg fence. Superb batting this from Oman so far.
Another ball on the pads, Khawar this time eases the ball through mid on for a single.
SIX! Khawar Ali has moved to 31 off just 15 balls. Viljoen continues bowling the ball short and on the leg side. Khawar has no problems in depositing this ball over the deep mid-wicket fence.
Change of ends for Christi Viljoen. 1-0-12-0 so far.
Around middle and leg this time, Ilyas flicks it behind square for a couple this time. 10 from the over.
Misfield now! Fuller around off, Ilyas drives it through mid off where the fielder allows the ball go through. It goes towards long on and the batters take two.

FOUR! Shortish length this time, Ilyas pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. Deep square leg fielder puts in a valiant effort to keep the ball in the play. He does so by diving to his left but the ball parries to the fence eventually.
Beaten! Good ball this one. Length ball in the channel, shapes a hint away as Ilyas looks to defend it towards the off side and beats the outside edge.
Length ball on the pads, Ilyas flicks it towards deep mid-wicket and scampers back for a couple.
Around off, Ilyas blocks it back to the bowler.
JJ Smit into the attack now.
FOUR! Poor bowling this. Short ball around middle, Khawar picks his spot beautifully and hammers the ball to the mid-wicket fence.
On middle, Khawar pushes it back to the bowler. Frylinck picks the ball in his followthrough and fires a throw back to the striker's end. Hits the batsman with the throw there.
FOUR! Hammered away! Full outside off, Khawar creams the cover drive to perfection this time. He is looking in superb nick here.

Good length ball on middle, Khawar looks to slam it over the long on fence but mistimes the ball towards mid on. The fielder comes to field but fumbles. The ball starts going towards the fence but the fielder does well to keep the ball in play. A couple.
Length ball on the pads, Aaqib tucks it behind square for a single.
On middle, Aaqib keeps it out.
Bouncer around off, Khawar looks to pull but misses.
Full around off, Khawar comes forward to block.
Around off, Ali defends it out.
FOUR! Hat-trick of boundaries! Wide outside off this time. Khawar drives it through the covers and finds the gap to perfection. The ball races to the deep point fence.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries now! Poor bowling from Viljoen. Short and on the leg side. Khawar goes back and hammers the pull shot through mid-wicket.
FOUR! Poor start and punished too. Short and outside off, Khawar Ali ramps it over cover-point to get a boundary through the off side.
Christi Viljoen to bowl from the other end.
On middle again, Ali works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Good length ball on middle, Ali looks to flick but is hit on the pads. A mild appeal but nothing from the umpire.
On middle, Aqib pushes it towards mid on and crosses for a run.
Full ball on the pads, Ali flicks it towards deep square leg for a single to get off the mark.
Aaqib Ilyas is in at 3.

OUT! Jatinder departs for a golden duck and it is a perfect start for Namibia. Good length ball on middle, it swings a bit as Jatinder flicks. The ball goes behind square leg where Davin runs to his left and takes a fine catch to send the opener packing.
Frylinck starts with a length ball closer to the off pole, Ali pushes it towards cover and takes a single.

We are back for the run chase. Omani openers Jatinder Singh and Khawar Ali are out in the middle. The Namibian side is also on the field. Jan Frylinck to start the proceedings for Namibia. Khawar Ali to face the first ball.
